clips.title: What is Prompt Caching? Optimize LLM Latency with AI Transformers
clips.why: How prompt caching works: what is stored, and why the prefix must be exactly the same.
look: Why only the beginning of a request can be reused.

practice.q: Keep the cache alive while Nova waits up to an hour for a person.
practice.hint: One of the only two accepted values.
practice.why: 1h survives a wait for a person; 5m would expire and the prefix would be written again.

options.why: Planning needs the strongest model, and fuzzy tickets get high effort.

options.text: A helper that searches the code and returns file:line pointers
options.why: Reading and searching is cheap work; the cheapest model is enough.
Building goes to Opus 5.5 at medium, and one level up only when its checks fail.

practice.q: A step's checks fail. Put what the harness does in order.
items: Look up the step's route, for example Opus 5.5 at medium
Raise effort one level with applyFlagSettings in the running session
Send the retry as a new user message into the same session
The next request reads most of its prefix from the cache
If the checks fail again, leave it to the progress watcher
practice.why: One retry, one level up, same session. The cache keeps the retry cheap, and the watcher decides what happens after that.

practice.q: Keep PATH and HOME in the claude process when you set env.
practice.why: env replaces the whole environment of the child process. Without the spread it has no PATH or HOME.
